templateInstructions.dailyBriefing: Every morning, give me a fun quote of the day, summarize my top important emails, list any meetings today from my calendar, and tell me the weather for [my city].
templateInstructions.researchMonitor: Search for the latest news and papers on [your topic]. Summarize the top 3 most relevant findings and explain why they matter.
templateInstructions.codeReviewer: Review the latest commits in [repo]. Check for bugs, security issues, and style violations. Summarize findings with file paths and line numbers.
templateInstructions.meetingPrep: Before my next meeting, pull context from my emails, messages, and past meetings with the attendees. Summarize key topics and suggest talking points.
templateInstructions.personalDeepResearch: Search across all my personal data — messages, emails, meetings, documents, and notes — to answer [my question]. Cite your sources.
templateInstructions.inboxTriager: Check my recent emails and messages. Categorize them by priority (urgent, important, FYI, spam). Summarize the top items I should act on.

slack.description: DM your agent in any Slack workspace
slack.step1: 1. Go to api.slack.com/apps → click "Create New App" → choose "From an app manifest"
slack.step2: 2. Select your workspace. When asked for the manifest format, choose JSON. Then paste the manifest below (click "Copy" to copy it):
slack.step3: 3. Click "Next" → review the summary → click "Create". Then go to "Install App" in the left sidebar → click "Install to Workspace" → click "Allow"
slack.step4: 4. In the left sidebar, click "OAuth & Permissions". Copy the "Bot User OAuth Token" (starts with xoxb-...)
slack.step5: 5. In the left sidebar, click "Basic Information" → scroll to "App-Level Tokens" → click "Generate Token and Scopes" → name it "socket" → click "Add Scope" → select "connections:write" → click "Generate" → copy the token (starts with xapp-...)
slack.step6: 6. (Optional) Still in "Basic Information", scroll to "Display Information" → upload the Nicx icon as the app icon
slack.step7: 7. Paste both tokens below and click Connect
slack.howToUse: Open Slack and DM @Nicx to talk to your agent.
